title: 约翰·特努斯能否为苹果找到下一个大事件？
summary: 本文是 The Verge 播客节目的一期内容，主持人对话彭博社首席苹果记者马克·古尔曼（Mark Gurman），他也是即将推出的播客《Power On》的主持人。讨论围绕苹果公司近期举办的年度 iPhone 硬件发布会展开，该发布会的几乎所有细节在正式发布前都已被提前报道。对话的核心议题是：在蒂姆·库克之后，苹果硬件工程高级副总裁约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）能否带领苹果找到下一个重大产品方向。内容涉及苹果在 AI、Siri、iPhone 等领域的未来战略，以及苹果当前面临的创新压力与领导层接班问题。古尔曼作为全球消息源最可靠的苹果记者，提供了关于苹果内部动态和未来产品路线图的深度分析。
summary_en: This episode of The Verge podcast features host Nilay Patel in conversation with Mark Gurman, Bloomberg's chief Apple correspondent and host of the upcoming Power On podcast. The discussion centers on Apple's annual iPhone hardware event, nearly every detail of which was reported ahead of time. The core question is whether John Ternus, Apple's senior vice president of hardware engineering, can find Apple's next big thing after Tim Cook. The conversation touches on Apple's future strategy in AI, Siri, and iPhone, as well as the company's innovation pressures and leadership succession. Gurman, widely regarded as the best-sourced Apple reporter, offers deep analysis of Apple's internal dynamics and product roadmap.
